item.text:
**Bottom Line**  
Mixed, leaning weakly positive on formalization and staffing, but weak on transparent correction. The clearest evidence is that IMSS-Bienestar used formal operating rules, measured coverage, and basified/hired staff at scale. The clearest counterevidence is that social transfers were politically timed and that transparency/oversight institutions remained weak, which limits confidence that AMLO used measurement and correction in a systematic way.

**Positive Evidence**
- [IMSS-Bienestar se consolida con egreso, contratación de especialistas y basificación de personal](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202402/095) | IMSS | 2024-02-27 | IMSS said 2024 would be the biggest year for graduating and hiring specialists and that more than 25,000 IMSS-Bienestar health workers had been regularized. This is direct evidence of using staffing rules and formal basification to improve service delivery. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`
- [IMSS-Bienestar opera en 23 entidades para atender a 53.2 millones de mexicanos que no tienen seguridad social](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202404/170) | IMSS | 2024-04-17 | IMSS-Bienestar reported a measured rollout with 131,000 workers, 635 hospitals, and 11,913 health centers serving 53.2 million uninsured people. The use of explicit coverage and staffing metrics supports a technocratic delivery model. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- [ACUERDO mediante el cual se establecen las Reglas de Operación del Programa IMSS-Bienestar para el ejercicio fiscal 2024](https://sidof.segob.gob.mx/notas/docFuente/5713366) | Diario Oficial de la Federación / IMSS | 2024 | The 2024 rules of operation define IMSS-Bienestar through specific medical, finance, and administration units and frame it as a constitutional-rights service system. That is strong evidence of formal, rule-based management rather than ad hoc patronage. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`
- [Entrega directa de Programas para el Bienestar abate la corrupción](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/entrega-directa-de-programas-para-el-bienestar-abate-la-corrupcion/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-10-17 | The government said direct deposits to Banco del Bienestar cards eliminated intermediaries and commission-taking. This is evidence of an attempt to use administrative design to reduce leakage and improve delivery. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`
- [Gobierno federal amplía por 3 meses contratos a trabajadores de salud de estados no federalizados](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202406/306) | IMSS | 2024-06 | The federal government extended contracts for 1,579 health workers to prevent service disruption while states decided on federalization. That suggests adaptive management aimed at continuity rather than political patronage. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`

**Negative / Mixed Evidence**
- [Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18 | The government advanced welfare payments before the electoral blackout. That is patronage-sensitive timing and does not show transparent correction based on performance feedback. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- [Bienestar no entrega préstamos ni créditos a cuenta de los Programas del Bienestar](https://www.gob.mx/bienestar/prensa/bienestar-no-entrega-prestamos-ni-creditos-a-cuenta-de-los-programas-del-bienestar) | Secretaría de Bienestar | 2024-07-30 | The ministry had to warn that no official loans or cash advances were being offered through messages or intermediaries. This suggests persistent fraud and intermediary problems, which weakens the claim of clean, data-driven service management. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`
- [World Report 2024: Mexico](https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | HRW said AMLO and his party blocked appointments to INAI, weakening access-to-information oversight. That undercuts transparent correction because effective measurement and public feedback depend on functioning oversight institutions. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- [IMSS-Bienestar opera en 23 entidades para atender a 53.2 millones de mexicanos que no tienen seguridad social](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202404/170) | IMSS | 2024-04-17 | The scale claims are large, but they are still official self-reporting rather than an independent audit showing service improvements followed from measured correction. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`
- [IMSS-Bienestar se consolida con egreso, contratación de especialistas y basificación de personal](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202402/095) | IMSS | 2024-02-27 | The staffing expansion is real evidence of formalization, but not direct proof that leadership used evidence of poor performance to revise policy. It supports competence more than transparent corrective learning. QIDs: `6B.5`, `6B.4`

**Search Gap**
- I found strong evidence of formalization, staffing, and anti-intermediary design, but little independent 2024 evidence of a visible correction loop: public dashboards, external audits, or explicit admission of service failure followed by measurable course correction.
- Most positive material is official and programmatic, not third-party evaluation.
- So the best-supported judgment is: some evidence-based administration, but transparent correction is only weakly demonstrated.
